name: agentic-quality-engineering-demo
description: A full-lifecycle Agentic Quality Engineering lab covering risk-based functional, data, integration, security, performance, and continuous quality validation.

scripts.test:functional: cross-env QA_SUITE=functional playwright test tests/api tests/refund tests/ui tests/a11y --project=chromium
scripts.test:allure: npm run evidence:prepare && npm run test:unit && npm run test:functional && npm run test:integration && npm run test:security && npm run evidence:generate && npm run allure:generate
scripts.test:portfolio: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('allure-results/portfolio',{recursive:true,force:true})" && cross-env QA_SUITE=portfolio ALLURE_RESULTS_DIR=allure-results/portfolio playwright test --project=portfolio-showcase && allure generate allure-results/portfolio --clean -o reports/allure-portfolio
scripts.allure:generate: allure generate allure-results/current --clean -o reports/allure-current && node scripts/prepare-report.mjs
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run evidence:prepare && npm run test:unit && npm run test:functional && npm run test:integration && npm run test:security && cross-env REQUIRED_EVIDENCE=unit,functional,integration,security npm run evidence:generate
